mapper.select: SELECT id, reagent_id, reagent_name, reagent_type, reagent_specs_num, threshold, usable FROM tb_screen_consume WHERE reagent_id = #{reagentId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_screen_consume SET usable = 1 WHERE reagent_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_screen_consume SET usable = 0 WHERE reagent_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: select c.* from tb_screen_reagent r left join tb_screen_consume c on c.reagent_id=r.id where c.current_number >0 and c.deleted=0 and c.dept_id=#{deptId} and r.deleted=0 and c.usable=0 and c.reagent_id=#{reagentId}
select ifnull(sum(current_number),0) from tb_screen_consume where usable=0 and deleted=0 and reagent_id=#{reagentId} and dept_id=#{deptId}
select consume_order from tb_screen_consume WHERE deleted = 0 and dept_id=#{deptId} and reagent_id=#{reagentId} order by consume_order desc limit 1
